name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for kitchen cabinet removal varies depending on the size of the kitchen, the number of cabinets, and the complexity of the installation. A small kitchen with standard cabinetry might take a few hours, while a large kitchen with custom or integrated units could take a full day or more. Factors like existing plumbing or electrical connections within cabinets can also influence the timeline. Our team aims for efficient and thorough removal to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removal time varies, typically from a few hours for small kitchens to a full day for larger, more complex layouts. Factors include kitchen size and cabinet type.
